S:
# Compute receipts with apple pie purchases and receipts where customer id 12 shopped, then union.

# Note: baskets has item_1..item_5 (strings of product ids). shopper_receipts columns are named like c10013, etc.; no c12 exists per schema, so customer 12 has no receipts in table_3 and contributes nothing.

# 1) Create a temp table of receipts containing an Apple Pie item by normalizing basket items and joining to products.
db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_apple_receipts AS
WITH basket_long AS (
  SELECT receipt, item_1 AS item_id FROM baskets WHERE item_1 IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT receipt, item_2 FROM baskets WHERE item_2 IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT receipt, item_3 FROM baskets WHERE item_3 IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT receipt, item_4 FROM baskets WHERE item_4 IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT receipt, item_5 FROM baskets WHERE item_5 IS NOT NULL
), apple_items AS (
  SELECT id FROM products WHERE kw ILIKE '%apple%' AND sw ILIKE '%pie%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT b.receipt
FROM basket_long b
JOIN apple_items a ON b.item_id = a.id
""")

# 2) Attempt to extract receipts for customer id 12. If column c12 exists use it, else create an empty temp.
cols_df = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, "PRAGMA table_info('shopper_receipts')")
col_names = set(cols_df['name'].tolist())
if 'c12' in col_names:
    db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
    CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_r12 AS
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(receiptnumber AS BIGINT) AS receipt
    FROM shopper_receipts
    WHERE c12 IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(c12), '') IS NOT NULL
    """)
else:
    db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
    CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_r12 AS
    SELECT CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS receipt WHERE 1=0
    """)

# 3) Union and output a small, ordered preview.
db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT DISTINCT receipt FROM tmp_apple_receipts
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT receipt FROM tmp_r12
ORDER BY receipt
LIMIT 50
""")
